description: Ministry of Home Affairs official portal for reporting cybercrimes against women and children, online financial fraud, cyberstalking, and non-consensual image sharing.

resource_name: Tele-MANAS (Tele Mental Health Assistance and Networking Across States)
description: Government of India 24x7 toll-free mental health helpline providing psychological support, crisis counseling, and suicide prevention assistance operated by NIMHANS.
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment helpline offering early screening, psychological first aid, cognitive emotional support, and distress management.

resource_name: National Commission for Women (NCW) Cyber Cell & Helpline
description: NCW dedicated helpline for women facing online cyber harassment, morphing, extortion, cyberstalking, and non-consensual dissemination of intimate images.
Ministry of Women and Child Development emergency phone outreach service for minors and adolescents facing school cyberbullying, online grooming, or exploitation.
Free confidential psychological counseling and suicide prevention hotline for individuals experiencing cyberbullying-induced trauma, anxiety, and depression.
